overview: A secular young man raised in Australia undergoes a profound spiritual awakening after falling in love with the daughter of a prominent Islamic scholar, only for their matrimonial aspirations to be jeopardized by a pre-arranged betrothal mandated by her traditionalist family.

title: No Pain
overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

title: 100 Days
overview: 100 Days is a feature film about Brazilian explorer Amyr Klink, who crossed the South Atlantic Ocean in 1984. It blends adventure, family drama, and emotional flashbacks from his childhood and teen years.

title: What Lies Between Us
overview: A quiet suburban community is shaken by the alleged sexual assault of a teenage boy by two of his peers. As the town reels, successful real estate agent Anne Sofie discovers her own son may be more involved than she imagined. Determined to protect him and the family's reputation, she makes a choice that sets her on a collision course with the other boys' mothers, Sarah and Ulrikke. As accusations against her son begin to spread, the pressure mounts and to shield her family, Anne Sofie pins the blame on one of the other boys. But as her relationships fracture and her moral compass wavers, she’s forced to make a life-altering decision.

title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

title: La bola negra
overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

title: UNABOMBER
overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: NAZA
overview: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

title: Premada Oorali
overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

title: Meesaya Murukku 2
overview: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

title: Dorothy
overview: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

title: The Deputy
overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: The Stunt Driver
overview: Based on a true story, a Canadian stunt driver recruits a top sports manager and rocket car designers to attempt a record-breaking jump across the Saint Lawrence River, hoping to achieve fame and fortune.

title: 超级玩家·芭莎之夜 红毯全程
The Patrick Star Show: Week of Stars!
overview: A Mini-Series from the fifth season of The Patrick Star Show containing the episodes "Gone Bootin'," Roller Bunny," "Squ-AD-ina," "Don't Friend the Reaper." and "Pat Alone... At Home"

title: The Other
overview: A short mystery horror film written and directed by filmmaker Hakeem Ahmed.  What begins as an ordinary Saturday for Salim quickly takes a disturbing turn when he notices someone is following him.  A stranger.  The same clothes.  The same places.  Always there.  An unsettling coincidence soon becomes something far more disturbing.  As the day descends into paranoia and fear, Salim is finally forced to confront the person who has been stalking him.  Some things are better left unknown.

title: Don't Be Shy!
overview: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

title: First Time?
overview: A boozy Friday night hangout turns sour once a scarring memory takes control.

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: The Journey of Heroes
overview: The Journey of Heroes follows Ny (Steven Nguyễn), who, after rescuing his younger sister from a human trafficking ring along the Western border, is captured alongside his best friend and forced into slavery inside a brutal scam compound. There, together with undercover investigators and fellow victims suffering in silence, they secretly devise a daring plan to escape.

title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
overview: When Peppa learned that her family wouldn't be going on vacation this year, she was very disappointed. However, a sudden storm transported her to faraway China! Peppa embarked on a wonderful adventure until she was reunited with her family, and Peppa had the perfect vacation ever.

title: Love Lottery
overview: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

title: Our Walls
overview: An animated documentary that, through an intimate conversation between a daughter and a mother, searches for understaning and explores family bonds. The film reveals the inner conflict between freedom and sacrifice. Gradually, walls that connect and confine us across generations emerge, shaping who we are to ourselves and to one another.

title: Attention Seeker
overview: The Powers, a picturesque family. David Powers, a classic country singer with a comeback album on the horizon works away with his tools on the grounds of the estate. Janet Powers, the matriarch of the house toiling away in the kitchen preparing a feast for the family. Ben Powers, buried amongst the various computer windows of gameplay, text chats, and live streaming feeds. And Grace, dejected with a black eye starring into old pictures of days when she thought she was happy. One click is all it would take, it wouldn't undo any of what she's been through, and yeah it would probably make it all worse, she'd be attacked by everyone, the whole family would. A single click on the 'publish' button, and everything would come out, everything about her father, what it's like to live in this house. 'Why not' she thinks, 'I won't be here to see it, burn it all down'.

title: Ballroom
overview: A devastating accident forces aspiring dancer Violet to relearn life in a wheelchair. Through dance and an unexpected bond, she discovers that dreams don't disappear - they transform.

title: Stolen Heart
overview: A shy recovering kleptomaniac risks his sobriety when his crush encourages him to help her steal an artifact from a museum.

title: Pauline
overview: The story of Pauline Julien, a singing icon and independence activist, across several decades of Québec history.

title: Strindbergs Ensam
overview: Based on Strindberg's autobiographical book of the same name. Is it better to self isolate than to put in all the work it takes to maintain a social life?

title: Kraken
overview: In a housing project, an abandoned tower fuels rumors. As strange disappearances multiply, five young people have no choice but to enter once again. Trapped in a deadly snare, they will soon realize that escaping will be impossible…

title: Us
overview: In a country marked by violence, a group of incarcerated women participates in a film workshop inside a prison in Guayaquil. As they film their daily lives, stories of love, guilt, and forced separation from their children emerge. Through games and confessions, the camera creates a space for resistance, where imagination transcends the prison’s boundaries and allows them to explore other ways of being.

title: We Are Aliens
overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

title: Lenin Pandiyan
overview: Set alongside on the riverbanks of Maanamadurai in the Sivagangai district, the premise is about a very gullible, innocent old couple in their late 60s, 70s who inadvertently get intertwined in the political lobby of sand mining which is currently a major issue in the local district.

title: Dubbio nel buio
overview: A detective consumed by obsession. A killer who has stayed in the shadows for years, and a question that keeps coming back: where does the world end, and where do we begin?

title: Matched: True Love
overview: At a secluded island resort, a matchmaking tour turns into a deadly game when buried secrets surface — forcing a survivor of past app-related murders to fight for her life once again.

title: Dunhuang Warriors
overview: During a time of unrest in Shazhou, a once-prosperous Tang Dynasty outpost now under Tibetan control, a rebellion led by Zhang Yichao sparks hope for liberation. As the conflict intensifies, a group of unlikely heroes—including a thief, a deserter, and a general’s daughter—unite to fight for their people’s freedom.

title: Invention 13
overview: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

title: Meta
overview: When two young adults meet in the laundry room, they get into a relationship but they soon realize the world they live in has a lot more to do with the way they are able to give and receive love.

title: De berg
overview: Isabel, thirty-ish and beyond happy, is approached by a secretive firm. The offer? To disappear and start all over again. She laughs it off. It's an absurd suggestion, a joke - right up until her life starts falling apart.

title: Burdened
overview: After a tragic car crash leaves their mother in a coma, 19-year-old Dakota is forced into adulthood as she becomes the primary caregiver for her younger brother, Zach, a young boy struggling with severe ADHD. Torn between grief, guilt, and her own stalled future, she must decide how much of herself she can give without disappearing.

title: Hunted
overview: In the midst of the 2017 Chechen gay purge, a young gay man is arrested, tortured, and forced into an impossible choice: betray the people he loves or die for them. He must summon the courage to defy a system determined to erase him.

title: Ang Paroroonan
overview: A store where the lost, the searching, the waiting, and those headed toward a destination come to a stop.

title: Gebroken hart
overview: While her schoolfriends look forward to adulthood, eighteen-year-old Tasnim struggles with the consequences of her donor heart, which means hospital visits between exams, and sometimes having to scale back her dreams for the future.

title: Dhevi
overview: Twin sisters Maahi and Maashi are haunted by the consequences of a curse cast before they were born. As terror closes in, buried family secrets surface, forcing them into a desperate fight against an evil determined to claim them forever.

title: Koplopers
overview: When five football hooligans from the south of the Netherlands take part in a social experiment, a confrontational group game exposes hidden vulnerabilities and challenges their loyalty, leading the group to unravel.

title: Obscure Identity
overview: In an era of sensory overload and conspiracy, the line between truth and delusion is razor thin. When a woman is stuck in the liminal space of an airport baggage claim, she must know the difference before paranoia (or worse) consumes her.

title: Pumpkin Regatta Romance
overview: When their fathers refuse to move past a disagreement, Nadine, daughter of the boat shop owner, and Ethan, a pumpkin farmer, team up to heal the feud and revive the town's Pumpkin Regatta.

title: Children of the Sun
overview: Four friends from Berlin spend their summer in Greece trying to free themselves of all societal norms and conventions. They throw away their phones, open their relationships and begin to question all mental and physical limits in search of freedom. But just as their newfound utopia unfolds, forest fires erupt around their camp. The four friends realize that they might have to leave the country and above all, their youthful ideals behind.

title: Eyes on the Street
overview: Eyes on the Street, through three different public spaces in Istanbul, tells the story of who uses and transforms the city and its public spaces, and how these spaces are used. Who truly owns a city's common spaces, and who decides how those spaces will be used?

title: Gourmet
overview: A man serves an over-done date night with undercooked intentions.

title: Family Game Night
overview: A well-meaning mom tries to unite her fractured family with a seemingly innocent game night. Amid sibling rivalries and issues with Maya's new boyfriend, the evening spirals into chaos until an unexpected truth offers a fragile chance at healing.

title: Changed Forever
overview: CHANGED FOREVER tells the raw and inspiring true story of Alexis, a woman consumed by the darkness of addiction, teetering on the brink of self-destruction. Her life is a whirlwind of bad choices and devastating consequences, leaving her isolated and hopeless. Just when she believes all is lost, a flicker of faith ignites within her. Driven by desperation, her unwavering faith culminates in a profound, life-altering encounter with God, an experience that shatters her old life and rebuilds her from the ground up. CHANGED FOREVER follows Alexis's arduous journey to sobriety, healing, and ultimately, redemption. More than just a story of overcoming addiction, CHANGED FOREVER is a testament to the transformative power of faith and prayer, offering a beacon of hope to anyone struggling to find their own new beginning.

title: A Better Jianghu
overview: Two individuals, the scholar Shen Fang and the knight-errant Luo Han, steal a huge sum of silver from the official Qin Hui to support the anti-Jin rebels, devising a grand deception to combat the imperial guard and rally people from all walks of life to their cause during the Southern Song Dynasty.

title: This gap is (immeasurable)
overview: He and she, an improbable couple locking eyes in a provincial train station, become the protagonists of a great centrifugal choreography, crossing through the most genuine cinematic traditions: an urban symphony of the Romanian South, a music video with a fantastic rhythm, a B action-film, and part TikTok doomscrolling.

title: NOSEBLEED
overview: When unresolved trauma resurfaces, the restless Maya is forced to confront her spiraling nature, both that of victim and that of perpetrator.  NOSEBLEED is a raw, semi-autobiographical dance film in which the border between reality and fiction blurs in a provocative exploration of desire and power.

title: Erva
overview: Someone is living in Erva's house... Wandering around, eating her food from the fridge, rearranging her belongings, and even sleeping in her bed while she's away.

title: Mrs Dogfire
overview: An homage to Mrs Doubtfire in which a man dresses as a dog to unite a family.

title: Il mio nome è Carlo
overview: The movie traces three key moments: the six-year-old boy, already driven by an extraordinary spiritual sensitivity; the eleven-year-old boy, curious and brilliant; and the fifteen-year-old in his first year of high school, self-aware and determined, capable of approaching everyday life with an extraordinary outlook.

title: Stalker
overview: She thought she could leave the past behind… but the past refuses to let go.  A secret love. A broken promise. An obsession that turns deadly.  Some choices can’t be erased… and some secrets can’t stay hidden forever.

title: Old Skin
overview: For seven years, Simon documents his visits to his great-aunt on camera. Amid absurd moments and glimpses into an eventful life, a portrait emerges of a woman who is as headstrong as she is endearing.

title: No One Leaves
overview: When Meredith and her husband go to have dinner with their neighbor on the next farm over, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith begins to suspect that this young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: Sales Assistant
overview: On a sales day, a 28-year-old Latina migrant works at a fast fashion store in the Netherlands, surviving a job she cannot afford to lose as her body starts to resist.

title: BOMBAY STORIES
overview: Adapted from the short stories of Pakistani writer Saadat Hasan Manto, the film interweaves the lives of three sex workers and their pimps.

title: The Opposite Show
overview: A game show where only one of the contestants is in on the rules.

title: Old Knobbley
overview: In 17th century England, two women persecuted for witchcraft find sanctuary and safety at the site of a five-hundred oak tree.

title: November Men
overview: Two men meet at a closed nightclub for a conversation that will alter the course of history.

title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.

title: FULGOR
overview: A visual project accompanying FULGOR, the latest project by ecuadorian band Verde 70, that translates the album's universe into an audiovisual language.

title: DEQ
overview: "DEQ" is a legacy in Kurdish Culture. A bridge between Human and Nature and a way to find meaning of life.

title: La jangada
overview: La Jangada is the union of 35 musicians embraced by nature with a common goal: to bring to life songs that are born from the heart of this country.  In search of the vastness that these songs convey, we wanted to bring a piece of Santiago del Estero's land straight to the Río de La Plata.

title: Deathgasm II: Goremageddon
overview: After failing to reform his heavy metal band DEATHGASM for a battle-of-the-bands to win back his girlfriend Medina, Brodie decides to use black magic to raise his ex-band members Zakk and Dion from the dead. However, his resurrected friends become unpredictable and dangerous, leading to chaos in the town.

title: Farewell
overview: A short film for NOTODO Film Fest.  In 1936, a man tries to flee his home in secret. But his daughter crosses his path before he can step through the doorway.

title: Portrait
overview: When Emil’s grandfather, Ah Gong, nears the end of his life, he leaves Emil one final request: inherit his sacred duty, photographing the dead and capturing their final words before they move on. Threading the fragile balance of fulfilling this sacred duty and making time for his loved ones, Emil struggles to live in the present as he knows the dead cannot wait, but how much more can the living?

title: WOLFSTORY (PILOT)
overview: Set in a dark world filled with ancient magic, WOLFSTORY follows three young wolves who set out on a quest to save their pack and rewrite their own stories.

title: The Nice Ones
overview: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

title: Crooked Miles
overview: Desperate people receive a mystical gift that grants wishes, collects souls, and creates monsters.

title: Ghost Light
overview: Actress Marion Neal finds herself mired in a lawsuit over the rights to her playhouse. As strange occurrences begin to take place, the hidden truth emerges regarding an intricate web of interwoven conspiracies and villainous agendas.

title: Love - Love
overview: LOVE - LOVE is the story of two brothers : Andy, who suffers from schizophrenia, and Jeff, an actor in search of success and meaning in his life. After the death of their grandmother, Andy is left without a « caretaker ». Refusing to live in a group home, he insists on moving in with their father, Bruce, whom they lost touch with after he fled his responsibilities. The two brothers then set out on a road trip to find their father, a disgraced former professional tennis player, now living in seclusion near the Salton Sea, in the California desert.

title: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
overview: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

title: Always Yours, Never Mine
overview: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

title: Reawakened Man
overview: Despite unwavering support from his best friend Young-ha and the unwavering support of his younger sister Ye-rin, job seeker Seok Hwan just can't seem to land a job, repeatedly failing interviews. One night, after yet another disastrous interview, he returns home only to be attacked by a group of strangers and killed. But 72 hours after his death, Seok Hwan suddenly opens his eyes as if nothing happened. He soon discovers that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he comes back to life. But there's little time to process his extraordinary new power before a mysterious figure known as Black, who has discovered Hwan's existence, begins hunting him down.  Yet with each resurrection, Seok Hwan grows stronger, unleashing powers beyond anything he could have imagined!

title: Frankenstein Fragment
overview: Norbert Pfaffenbichler, master of the darkest avant-garde cinema, is also a veritable film archaeologist. No wonder, then, that his excavations of forgotten celluloid legacies unearthed a sensation: fragments of the very first film adaptation of Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, shot in Germany in 1922 and long believed to be lost, including test footage and outtakes. Pfaffenbichler and his team set about shaping this material of incredible historical value into a version that comes as close as possible to the original concept of its unknown filmmaker. Now, SLASH is unbelievably proud to present the resurrection of this lost film to the public for the very first time. (Markus Keuschnigg)

title: WWE/AAA Worlds Collide 2026: Chicago
overview: The 2026 Worlds Collide, also promoted as Worlds Collide: Chicago, was a professional wrestling live event co-produced by WWE and its sister promotion AAA. It was the sixth Worlds Collide under the WWE banner and the third between both promotions. It was filmed on September 26, 2026, at Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois, USA, but aired on September 30.

title: Atomic Eve
overview: In the year 2029, the world is at war. As announcements of incoming nuclear attack shake the United States, people of all walks of life scramble to reconcile with the end of the world.

title: Morbid Weekend
overview: A pizza delivery person dies on the job and a series of strange events follow.

title: Drury Lane
overview: A flat tire leaves realtor James stranded on the side of the road. He’s now at the mercy of a stranger who finds himself on the same road, on the same night, at the same time…

title: Melpomène
overview: Marthe discovers her mother’s death was a suicide, not an accident. At the hospital where she was once institutionalized, Marthe investigates the past—unraveling family secrets and facing a disturbing truth that threatens her grip on reality.

title: Sextape
overview: A young woman is recording her couple.

title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

title: A Man of His Time
overview: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin

title: It's How It Ends
overview: After being expelled from college, Owen returns home to disappointed parents and leaves in the middle of the night with his younger sister Mara, wandering the city and stumbling into unexpected encounters.

title: Monster
overview: Visiting his cousins in a small Anatolian town during a book tour, novelist Kemal joins them for a long-overdue family meal. What starts as an ordinary gathering filled with old grievances and petty disputes gradually unravels, exposing a deeply buried trauma from their shared past.

title: Hazirun
overview: In the early morning following a night shaken by citywide protests, Ali, a man in his twenties, is awakened by police sirens and forced to act as a “Hazirun” during a search of a neighboring apartment. Drawn into the process with no ability to intervene-valued only for his presence, signature, and silence-Ali becomes trapped in a gray zone between law, authority, and conscience, as events spiral out of control and irreversibly fracture his everyday life.

title: One Night at KitKat
overview: Berlin, Saturday night. Behind the doors of the legendary KitKatClub, a world unfolds that usually remains hidden. In a place where mobile phones are strictly forbidden, a camera was allowed inside. The founding duo looks back on the origins of the club—a venue that, like few others, epitomizes Berlin’s club culture, techno, the fetish scene, and sex-positive parties. Guests and staff share stories of self-acceptance, body positivity, and community. Intimate, unfiltered, and non-judgmental, the documentary offers an exclusive glimpse into a night at the KitKat.

title: The Doll
overview: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.
